personalInfo.name: Muhammad Afifudin
personalInfo.title: Web Application Developer, Backend Engineer, & Machine Learning Practitioner
personalInfo.subtitle: Specializing in Laravel, FastAPI, Scikit-Learn, and Scalable Web Systems
personalInfo.bio: IT graduate with hands-on experience in web application development, backend development, database management, and machine learning implementation. Experienced in building practical web-based systems using PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Python, and REST APIs. Developed projects involving course registration management, machine learning-based recommendation systems, and client-oriented digital solutions. Strong interest in software development, backend engineering, and building scalable, user-focused applications.

featuredProjects.title: Brilliant EdTech ML
featuredProjects.description: Machine learning-based system to recommend appropriate English learning levels based on student data. Implemented a Random Forest classification model integrated via FastAPI prediction services with a Laravel web portal for automated student level recommendations.

featuredProjects.title: Brilliant Course Registration Portal
featuredProjects.description: Web-based system for managing course marketing and student registration. Built using Laravel MVC architecture, Livewire interactive workflows, multi-step registration forms, Laravel Breeze authentication, and an administrative dashboard for programs, pricing, and registration data.

featuredProjects.title: Vehicle Monitoring Dashboard
featuredProjects.description: Web-based vehicle monitoring system for parking area at BUMDES Ponokawan Krian Cafe Dewi Pandawa. Integrates computer vision vehicle detection results into a centralized Laravel monitoring dashboard to display real-time vehicle activity.
